killedBy: modal isolation: a blocking overlay is really modal (issue #327) does NOT trap a route, because a full-screen destination is not a dialog
hud: the semantic action dispatcher (issue #494) Escape is Back with a volume slider focused, while ArrowDown stays with the slider (the consume model)
why: Traps every layer rather than the blocking kind, so opening Settings or Records isolates the rest of the HUD. That strands a player in a full-screen destination whose only exit is a Back button the trap keeps them from reaching -- strictly worse than the defect this feature fixes. `navigation.ts` already draws the line (an overlay is the blocking kind, and a route may not be pushed over one), which is why this reads the stack's own answer instead of inventing a second notion of "is a dialog". Notably it also breaks an EXISTING issue-#494 test about Escape with the volume slider focused, which is independent confirmation that routes must stay reachable.
